name: docforge
description: Design and generate a repository's documentation set — docs/ tree, README and ARCHITECTURE, decision records, limitations register, dependency inventory, security policy, error catalogs, data contracts, runbooks, plus Business Analyst and Product Owner audience overlays. Grounded in a knowledge-graph analysis of the actual source, with git-hash provenance so staleness is checked, not guessed. Host-neutral, with multi-repo collection discovery for diligence.

entries.name: docforge
entries.description: Design and generate a repository's documentation set — the docs/ tree, README and ARCHITECTURE, decision records (ADRs), a known-limitations register, a third-party dependency inventory, security policy, API error catalogs, data contracts and runbooks, plus Business Analyst and Product Owner audience overlays. Grounds every document in a knowledge-graph analysis of the actual source before writing, so nothing is invented, and stamps git-hash provenance so staleness is checked, not guessed. Host-neutral — works on any git host and never hardcodes one forge's paths, and discovers child repos before any multi-repo review.
